scope: Complete packaged probe-tile emission and six-plane prefix scans. Shader model 6.0 on Radeon and NVIDIA and a Radeon native wave64 reference using the same arithmetic. Verified outputs independently against CPU expectations.

681.cases: Four Z groups for four probe IDs, counter initially 3. Empty probes and inactive coefficients emit no tiles. The active case emits four level-one children for probe 0 and one level-zero tile for each other probe. All seven records, counter, and 8185 untouched tile slots checked.

1279.cases: 8x8 zero counts, 8x8 unit counts, 7x5 varying counts clipped in an 8x8 group. Six width-8 planes in a 10x50 allocation. All active prefix sums checked in Morton order, debug RGBA per pixel, six final counters, inactive pixels and counter guards.
